profile_text.body:
Hugging Face is a for-profit AI company founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company describes itself as engaged in a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science, and positions itself as a community platform for AI development.

The company's two tracked products are Hugging Face, a model hub relevant to AI supply-chain and AI bill-of-materials considerations, and Hugging Face Transformers, an open-source model hub and inference library noted for model card verification and security scanning capabilities. Both products are categorized under coding and developer tools and open-source and self-hosted models respectively.

The held facts record no litigation. Hugging Face has a registered MCP server, co.huggingface/hf-mcp-server, described as providing connection to Hugging Face Hub and thousands of Gradio AI applications. The company's law exposure is logged under New York, with a count of 260.
